title: Somebody’s Mother
subject: English
summary: “Somebody’s Mother” is a touching poem about an old and poor woman who stands alone in the cold near a school. One day, a group of schoolboys passes by her and makes fun of her. However, one kind-hearted boy stops and helps her cross the busy road safely. He does not expect any reward for his kindness. The old woman feels very happy and blesses him. The boy explains that he helped her because she could be someone's mother, just like his own mother. The poem teaches us that we should respect elderly people, help those in need and show kindness and compassion towards everyone.
